    revolve(axis=Axis.Y)

solid_body = p.part
tip_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Y)[-1]
tip_edges = tip_face.edges()
solid_body = chamfer(tip_edges, chamfer_size)

part = solid_body
part.name = "pin"
export_step(part, "output.step")
